specification.hypothesis: Across all DEV historical segments, 17.225 percent of AR8 squared residual sequences retain lag1 correlation above 0.1. separate_archive_raw_reproduction.raw_access: Existing workspace-contained junction to canonical data/raw. Training code only reads raw; no filesystem read-only ACL is claimed.

exact_predictive_state_reproduction.scope: Exact typed compact-tree arrays, column selection, configuration, calibration, representation/order and implementation identities in 15 CV plus 3 final artifact pairs. Native fitted estimator diagnostics are separately recorded. No training, prediction, scoring or target reads.
exact_predictive_state_reproduction.interpretation: Different joblib bytes do not imply different compact predictive state. No claim of complete native-estimator object equality or cross-platform execution equivalence is made.
